events.verdict: Wiggins (MIA) avoids making contact with Brown's (BOS) head as he defends the shot attempt.
Wiggins (MIA) is the last player to touch the ball before the ball goes out of bounds.  Possession is correctly awarded to the Celtics.
Adebayo (MIA) extends his forearm into Brown's (BOS) body and the contact affects his SQBR. This contact occurs prior to Brown's gather and a non-shooting foul is correctly assessed.

After communicating with the Replay Center, the ruling on the court (offensive basket interference) was overturned to an inadvertent whistle.  Hauser (BOS) makes contact with the ball after the ball has exited the imaginary cylinder above the basket ring.  The basket is scored and possession is awarded to the Heat.
White (BOS) legally contests Powell's (MIA) shot attempt.
Adebayo (MIA) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Wiggins (MIA) contests Brown (BOS)"s jump shot attempt and the marginal contact with their arm does not prevent them from following through.
Simons (BOS) moves alongside Herro's (MIA) path as he defends the shot attempt.
Herro (MIA) legally contests Simons' (BOS) jump shot attempt.
Adebayo (MIA) grazes Brown's (BOS) arm as he pursues the rebound.
The ball remains in bounds and Brown (BOS) legally saves the ball back in play.
Jakucionis (MIA) commits a take foul on Simons (BOS).
Wiggins (MIA) commits a take foul on Hauser (BOS).
White (BOS) avoids making contact with Powell's (MIA) arm as he defends the shot attempt.
Herro (MIA) commits a take foul on Simons (BOS).
